Name: Mini Garden Farm
Author: heathinwillows
Description:
xD, I wish I was a little deer wandering around a small garden deep in the heart of the forest.

the farm is surrounded by big trees which is why it's shady in here, mountain lake fish can be caught here and also lobsters and crabs via crabpots.

there's also two lesbian fairies here and 5 alcoholic ducks if you have the SH's Wild Animals mod, either the main one or the lite version. they're the previous owner of this place so be nice to them >:0

there's 2 starter gift options, so make sure you choose one on the config first before starting a new save

Farmer Starter Gift:
Strawberry Seeds - 5
Parsnip Seeds - 10
Scarecrow - 1
Seed Maker - 1
Preserves Jar - 1
Dehydrator - 1
Straw hat - 1
Small Glow Ring - 1

Fisher Starter Gift:
Strawberry Seeds - 5
Parsnip Seeds - 10
Scarecrow - 1
Seed Maker - 1
Bait Maker - 1
Fish Smoker - 1
Straw hat - 1
Small Glow Ring - 1

‎i also recommend playing this farm with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20537]PIF[/url] mods like:
‎
‎[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25435]Cozy Backyard[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28346]‎Enchanted Garden[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25942]‎Entrance to Narnia[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28298]‎Mountain Gardens[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29014]‎Secret Garden Springs[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28445]‎Vulkan Cave[/url]
‎
‎only if you want extra building and farming space
‎
‎you guys can use the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16873]Easy Farm Switcher[/url] mod so you could switch farms at ease mid game without losing ur progress trying a new farm:)))))
